sources.title: nsfw_image_detection by Falconsai, Image Classification | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, nsfw_image_detection runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of image classification data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.

sources.title: nsfw_image_detection: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview nsfw_image_detection is a fine-tuned Vision Transformer (ViT) model built by Falconsai for binary classification of images into "normal" or "nsfw" categories. The model uses the google/vit-base-patch16-224-in21k architecture as its foundation, pre-trained on ImageNet-21k and then fine-tuned on a proprietary dataset of 80,000 images with substantial variability.
